title: Hanoi Old Quarter walk
summary: A morning loop north of Hoan Kiem Lake through the guild streets, a market, and a lunch bowl.

stops.name: Hoan Kiem lakeshore
stops.note: Start at the northern edge of the lake.

stops.name: Hang Bac and the silver street
stops.note: Walk north. The trade names survive on the signs.

stops.name: Bach Ma Temple
stops.note: A small neighborhood temple on Hang Buom.

stops.name: Lunch
stops.note: Bun cha at lunch, around Cua Dong, then walk back to the lake on a different lane.

seoDescription: A three-hour morning walk through Hanoi’s Old Quarter.
